summary: This informational memo declares RFC 4148 and the IANA IPPM Metrics Registry obsolete. The registry was not detailed enough to uniquely identify IP performance metrics, and no one was found who used it. The registry is withdrawn.

eli5.summary: A list that was meant to name network measurements turned out too vague and unused. This note officially throws it away.

questions: is the ippm metrics registry obsolete
why was the ippm registry retired
